note: Four tunes of every difficulty with the chords off, in no stated order: Do found from the last note, a tune sung from the staff with the tune muted before it is heard, a tune where the singer hums Do before starting, and one sung a cappella from memory. Each stage names its button (Tune mutes the tune); the old Key choice is moves (key any) and its line opens with {{?key}}.

exercise.title: Tunes of every difficulty, chords off
exercise.why: With the chords off the tune is the only sound, so you find home from the tune itself: every tune in the book ends on Do, and its first note is a set distance from that ending.

cells.text:
The four tunes here are of every difficulty, in no order, and the chords are off, so only the tune tells you where {{1}} is.
Tap the last note of the tune below to hear {{1}}. Then press Play below to hear the tune alone: the mic starts with it. Listen once, then sing along. Sing it on "la".
If you lose {{1}} in the middle, tap the last note again, then sing along from the start.

cells.heading: Sing it before you hear it

cells.text:
Tap the last note of this tune below to hear {{1}}, and no other note. Then press Tune below to mute the tune.
Press Play below and sing the tune from the staff: the mic starts with it. Sing it on "la".
Press Tune again to bring the tune back, and sing along to check it. If your tune and the one you hear part ways, tap the note where they did and sing on from there.

Press Play below to hear the tune alone: the mic starts with it. Listen once, and hum its last note, {{1}}, when the tune stops.
Then sing along on "la", and take the top notes on "oo".
Practice until your first note is right without the hum.
{{?key}}In another key {{1}} moves, and the first note is still the same distance from it.

Press Play below to hear the tune alone, and only listen the first time.
Then press Tune below to mute the tune. Press Play again and sing the tune a cappella, from memory: the mic starts with it. Sing it on "la".
If {{1}} moved while you sang alone, tap the last note and start again from there.
